description: MANDATORY BEFORE CALLING: the user must have chosen BOTH sport and format for THIS tournament. If either is missing, ask instead of generating, or call get_supported_tournament_options to discover choices. Never infer sport or format from unrelated previous conversations, previous tool use, player/court counts or a default. 'Make a tournament for 20 players on four courts' requires clarification, not an Americano. Reuse choices explicitly confirmed earlier in this same tournament setup. Clarify individuals versus fixed teams when ambiguous. Use this when the user wants a PADEL Americano tournament (not pickleball; use generate_round_robin with rotating_doubles for pickleball rotating partners), rotating doubles partners, balanced rests and varied opponents. Plans rounds before play. Each entrant is an individual player. Always show the returned schedule in full, round by round: start time, court, both pairs and who rests. Never replace it with a summary. Set restMinutes when the user wants a break between rounds. After the schedule, pass on any warning about uneven rests and its suggested round counts. Does not save or publish an event; do not use for score-led Mexicano pairings.

names.description: Optional player names, or team names for fixed doubles. Supply exactly count names, or omit for numbered placeholders. Do not include contact details.

pointsPerMatch.description: Combined rally points shared by the two pairs, not points per pair. Both final scores must add to this number.

seed.description: Keep this value unchanged to reproduce a draw; change it only when requesting a new draw.

sport.description: Confirmed sport. NextArena offers padel Americano and Mexicano; ask for the sport if missing.

startTime.description: Local start time in HH:MM, 24-hour format.
